pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which tree is linked with Guru Nanak Dev Ji at Sultanpur Lodhi? (1 mark)
   A. Ber (Beri) tree
   B. Tulsi
   C. Bodhi tree
   D. Sal tree

2. What does water often stand for in religious life? (1 mark)
   A. Purity and a clean heart
   B. Anger
   C. Hunger
   D. Noise

3. Which faith honours the Bodhi tree most because of the Buddha? (1 mark)
   A. Sikhism
   B. Islam
   C. Jainism
   D. Buddhism

4. Which tree is linked with Lord Mahavir's enlightenment? (1 mark)
   A. Tulsi
   B. Ber tree
   C. Banana tree
   D. Sal tree

5. The Beas river is linked with which region of India? (1 mark)
   A. Bengal
   B. Punjab
   C. Gujarat
   D. Kerala

6. Which of these is a use of water at home? (1 mark)
   A. Making rocks
   B. Cooking food
   C. Producing sunlight
   D. Making the wind blow

7. Which sacred river of India did the lesson say is honoured as a goddess in the stories? (1 mark)
   A. Ganga
   B. Nzoia
   C. Beas
   D. Rijubalika

8. What do all four Enlightened Beings in the lesson teach in common? (1 mark)
   A. Kindness, truth and service
   B. Pride
   C. Anger
   D. Selfishness

9. What rescue is Parshvanath known for in a well-known story? (1 mark)
   A. A snake in a burning log
   B. A lost cow
   C. A drowning child
   D. A wounded swan

10. What are the Laavan? (1 mark)
   A. Festival songs of Maha Shivratri
   B. Yoga postures
   C. Hymns sung at a Sikh wedding
   D. Prayers before meals

11. In what language was the Ramayan first written? (1 mark)
   A. Gurmukhi
   B. English
   C. Kiswahili
   D. Sanskrit

12. How many directions (groups of people) does the Sigalovada Sutta list? (1 mark)
   A. Two
   B. Nine
   C. Six
   D. Four

13. What is the holy scripture of the Sikhs? (1 mark)
   A. Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji
   B. Ramayan
   C. Dhammapada
   D. Kalpasutra

14. What is the garbhagriha? (1 mark)
   A. The car park
   B. The inner room where the murti is placed
   C. The gate
   D. The kitchen

15. What does vidya mean in the prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Father
   B. Knowledge
   C. Friend
   D. Wealth

16. What is the main idea of the Saraswati Vandana? (1 mark)
   A. To ask for money
   B. To ask for rain
   C. To ask for food
   D. To ask for knowledge and remove ignorance

17. What does Saraswati hold in her hands in pictures? (1 mark)
   A. A drum and a flag
   B. A bow and arrow
   C. A sword and a shield
   D. A veena and a book

18. Which words begin the well-known Saraswati Vandana? (1 mark)
   A. Twameva mata cha pita twameva
   B. Om Namah Shivaya
   C. Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah
   D. Ya Kundendu Tushara Hara Dhavala

19. What should be written when an item is put in the lost and found? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. A secret code
   C. The date and the finder's name
   D. The price

20. Which is a benefit of integrity? (1 mark)
   A. We feel afraid
   B. People trust us
   C. People avoid us
   D. We are always angry

21. What did King Harishchandra give up rather than break his promise? (1 mark)
   A. His horse
   B. His lamp
   C. His kingdom
   D. His shoes

22. Which of these is honest saving? (1 mark)
   A. Taking from another's savings
   B. Borrowing secretly
   C. Saving your own money and not taking from others
   D. Hiding others' money

23. Which action during the journey is wrong? (1 mark)
   A. Speaking quietly
   B. Keeping the aisle clear
   C. Putting hands out of the window
   D. Sitting still

24. What is a common mistake about lies? (1 mark)
   A. Returning items
   B. Thinking honesty is important
   C. Owning up
   D. Thinking small lies do not matter

25. What does the story of Guru Nanak and Bhai Lalo teach? (1 mark)
   A. Honest earnings are best
   B. Rich people are wrong
   C. Cheating pays
   D. Wealth is proof of goodness

26. What should you wear for yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Tight clothes
   B. Loose and comfortable clothes
   C. Heavy boots
   D. A raincoat

27. Why do children work in pairs in yoga? (1 mark)
   A. To copy
   B. To check posture and encourage each other
   C. To argue
   D. To race

28. What is the benefit of Sasankasana? (1 mark)
   A. It makes the arms shorter
   B. It cures every disease
   C. It stretches the back and shoulders and relaxes
   D. It is useless

29. What should you do if you feel dizzy during yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Continue faster
   B. Hold your breath
   C. Ignore it
   D. Stop at once

30. According to the teaching, what happens to good actions? (1 mark)
   A. They bring good results
   B. They have no results
   C. They bring bad luck
   D. They are forgotten

31. Which important idea about the Purusharthas is taught? (1 mark)
   A. Wishes come first
   B. Ignore Dharma
   C. Wealth is all that matters
   D. Balance, with wealth and wishes following Dharma

32. What does Purushartha mean? (1 mark)
   A. A festival
   B. A prayer
   C. The goals of life
   D. A river

33. What does Paramatma mean? (1 mark)
   A. A holy river
   B. A festival
   C. The Supreme Soul
   D. A daily prayer

34. What do Jains say on the last day of Paryushan? (1 mark)
   A. Om Namah Shivaya
   B. Micchami Dukkadam
   C. Sat Sri Akal
   D. Namaste

35. Which is a use of the Panchang? (1 mark)
   A. Fixing the dates of festivals
   B. Cooking rice
   C. Keeping the school timetable
   D. Counting rainfall

36. What is the Sun in modern science? (1 mark)
   A. A planet
   B. A star
   C. A moon
   D. A comet

37. Which day is linked with Mercury? (1 mark)
   A. Sunday
   B. Friday
   C. Wednesday
   D. Tuesday

38. Which planet is famous for its rings? (1 mark)
   A. Mercury
   B. Venus
   C. Mars
   D. Saturn

39. What is the Indian name for Monday? (1 mark)
   A. Somvaar
   B. Budhvaar
   C. Guruvaar
   D. Ravivaar

40. Which is the last month listed in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Ashadha
   B. Chaitra
   C. Magha
   D. Phalguna

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Explain how a maize farm uses all five elements. (4 marks)

42. What does Prani Daya mean? (2 marks)

43. List three ideal practices of a passenger when boarding. (3 marks)

44. Explain what Maha Shivratri teaches. (4 marks)

45. Describe how Maha Shivratri is celebrated. (3 marks)

46. Why should we not bully others, according to the teachings in this lesson? (2 marks)

47. Compare Vajra Asana and Sasankasana. (5 marks)

48. Draw and label a simple Mandir. Name four features you would show. (4 marks)

49. On which date is Madaraka Day and what does Madaraka mean? (2 marks)

50. Name two trees or plants that are sacred in different faiths. (2 marks)

51. Write a short paragraph on why honesty is the best policy. (5 marks)

52. Explain the meaning of karma. (3 marks)

53. Why are Enlightened Beings considered inspiring? Use two examples. (5 marks)

54. What is the essence of a scripture? (2 marks)

55. Describe how the boy in the example story practised Asteya. (3 marks)

56. Explain why the River Rijubalika is important to Jains. (3 marks)

57. Explain four things a passenger should do when alighting. (4 marks)

58. Give two lessons of the Bal Kaand. (2 marks)

59. What does the name Narsimha mean? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Ber (Beri) tree
   The Ber Sahib stands beside a gurdwara in Sultanpur Lodhi.

2. A — Purity and a clean heart
   Because water cleans, it is a sign of purity.

3. D — Buddhism
   The Buddha became enlightened under a Bodhi tree.

4. D — Sal tree
   Jains say Lord Mahavir became enlightened under a sal tree.

5. B — Punjab
   The Beas flows in Punjab, where Sikhism began.

6. B — Cooking food
   We use water for cooking, drinking and washing.

7. A — Ganga
   In the stories Ganga is honoured as a goddess.

8. A — Kindness, truth and service
   Their teachings are alike in these values.

9. A — A snake in a burning log
   He asked the man to stop and the snake was saved.

10. C — Hymns sung at a Sikh wedding
   Guru Ram Das Ji wrote these wedding hymns.

11. D — Sanskrit
   It was written in Sanskrit by Valmiki.

12. C — Six
   It lists six groups.

13. A — Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji
   Sikhs follow it as their eternal Guru.

14. B — The inner room where the murti is placed
   It is the inner sanctum.

15. B — Knowledge
   Vidya is knowledge.

16. D — To ask for knowledge and remove ignorance
   It asks for a clear mind.

17. D — A veena and a book
   The veena and the book.

18. D — Ya Kundendu Tushara Hara Dhavala
   This is the opening line.

19. C — The date and the finder's name
   The book keeps a record.

20. B — People trust us
   Honest people are trusted.

21. C — His kingdom
   He gave up his whole kingdom.

22. C — Saving your own money and not taking from others
   Honest saving respects others.

23. C — Putting hands out of the window
   Hands can be hurt.

24. D — Thinking small lies do not matter
   Small lies grow.

25. A — Honest earnings are best
   Honest work is valued.

26. B — Loose and comfortable clothes
   Loose clothes help us move.

27. B — To check posture and encourage each other
   Pairs encourage and help.

28. C — It stretches the back and shoulders and relaxes
   It gently stretches and relaxes.

29. D — Stop at once
   Stop and rest.

30. A — They bring good results
   Good actions bring good results.

31. D — Balance, with wealth and wishes following Dharma
   Dharma guides the others.

32. C — The goals of life
   Purushartha means the goals of a person's life.

33. C — The Supreme Soul
   It is the highest soul, God.

34. B — Micchami Dukkadam
   It asks for forgiveness.

35. A — Fixing the dates of festivals
   It lists festival dates.

36. B — A star
   The Sun is a star.

37. C — Wednesday
   Budhvaar.

38. D — Saturn
   Saturn has bright rings.

39. A — Somvaar
   Som is the Moon.

40. D — Phalguna
   Phalguna is twelfth.

SECTION B
----
41. (4 marks)
   Answer: The soil is Prithvi, rain and river water are Jal, the sun's heat is Agni, the wind that carries pollen is Vayu, and the open sky is Akash.
   Working / marking points: Award 1 mark for each element linked correctly to the farm, up to 4.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: Kindness to all living beings.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for kindness and living beings.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wait for the vehicle to stop, form a line and do not push, let children and elders go first, pay the fare honestly (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: Self-control through fasting, faith through prayer, staying alert to do good, and thinking about our mistakes and trying to be better.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: People fast, keep an all-night vigil, bathe the Shiva Linga with water and milk, offer bel leaves, chant Om Namah Shivaya and visit the Mandir.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct practice.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Enlightened Beings teach kindness and Ahimsa, so we should not harm others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for kindness or Ahimsa, 1 mark for a link to bullying.

47. (5 marks)
   Answer: Vajra Asana is sitting on the heels with a straight back. Sasankasana starts in Vajra Asana and bends forward with the forehead on the mat and arms stretched forward. Both are calm and use steady breathing.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each pose and 1 mark for a similarity.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: A hall, a spire, a door with steps, a bell or flag, and the murti room (any four labelled).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct feature labelled.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: 1 June; power or authority to govern.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tulsi, Ber (Beri) tree, Bodhi tree, Sal tree (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct plant.

51. (5 marks)
   Answer: An honest person is trusted, feels calm, makes friends, keeps a good name and helps the community. A liar loses trust. Examples such as returning lost money or not cheating support the paragraph.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the topic, 2 marks for reasons, 1 mark for an example, 1 mark for a clear conclusion.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: Karma means action. Good actions bring good results and unkind actions bring trouble.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for action, 1 mark for good, 1 mark for unkind.

53. (5 marks)
   Answer: Their lives show courage, kindness and truth. For example, Prahlad's faith and Siddhartha's kindness to the swan. People follow their example.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the reason, 2 marks for each example, up to 5.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: The most important message or lesson in it.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for a correct meaning.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: He found a purse with money, did not keep it, and asked around until he found the owner.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for three points.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jains believe Lord Mahavir became fully enlightened while sitting on its bank, so the river is honoured in Jainism.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the Jain link, 1 mark for Lord Mahavir, 1 mark for enlightenment.

57. (4 marks)
   Answer: Wait for the vehicle to stop, take belongings, get off one at a time, look out for traffic, thank the driver (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: Respect for parents and teachers, love between brothers, courage to protect others, obedience to wise guidance (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: Man-lion, from nar (man) and simha (lion).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part.
